description.zh-CN: 在 RPEN 中导入/编辑/导出 Milthm 自制谱（fmt=2），轨道式。v0.7.5：「编辑事件列」列出所有事件种类（X/Y/旋转/不透明度/速度/大小X/大小Y/颜色/文字），勾选的列显示在左侧多线时间轴；导入谱不透明度按 Rain Editor 规则初始化（空列=1 不透明；有事件则 0 拍补一个 ≤1 拍、值=其后首个事件起始值）。v0.7.3：新建/新增线不透明度 255、时间轴表头语义名。v0.7.2：多线编辑事件类型下拉适配。v0.7.1：全部文字换随包 ChillRoundF（OFL-1.1）。
description.en-US: Import/edit/export Milthm fan charts (fmt=2) in RPEN. Track-based: each judge line = one Milthm track. v0.7.5: the "edit event columns" checkbox group lists all event kinds (X/Y/rotation/opacity/speed/sizeX/sizeY/color/text); checked kinds are shown as the left multi-line timeline columns. Imported-chart transparency initialisation follows Rain Editor (empty track = 1 opaque; with events -> a beat-0 event of at most 1 beat carrying the first event start value). v0.7.3: new/added lines opacity = 255, semantic timeline headers. v0.7.2: multi-line edit event-type dropdown follows the column mapping. v0.7.1: all RPEN text uses the bundled ChillRoundF font (SIL OFL-1.1).

description.zh-CN: 启用时用随模组分发的 ChillRoundF.ttf 覆盖 RPEN 文字：界面/按钮/下拉/输入框等所有 DOM 文本，以及所有用 RPE / RPEGame 字体族的画布文本（时间轴、预览文字、编号等）都会换成这个字体；关闭后恢复 RPEN 自带字体。（ChillRoundF 是第三方 OFL-1.1 字体，不是 PhiEdit 自带字体；许可证与版权声明随包。）
description.en-US: Overrides RPEN text with the bundled ChillRoundF.ttf: all DOM text (buttons, selects, inputs, textareas, kbd, code boxes) and all canvas text that uses the RPE / RPEGame families (timeline, preview text, line numbers). Disable to restore RPEN's own font. (ChillRoundF is a third-party OFL-1.1 font, not PhiEdit's bundled font; license and copyright notice ship with the package.)
